Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was making a left turn at an intersection in Pearland, Texas, when another vehicle struck the driver's side of my car.
I had the green light and was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic when the impact came. My airbags did not deploy,
but the force threw my body against the seatbelt and jolted me sideways. Since the collision I have been dealing with
stiffness and pain in my neck and lower back, which has made it hard to sit for long periods or lift anything heavy. I

nothing to add or change. I am the named driver on this policy, and I am submitting this claim for the damage to my
vehicle and for my medical treatment.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
